answer: One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is proof-of-burn staking: each agent must destroy a fixed amount of network credit to register, making fake identities costly. A thousand sybils means a thousand burned stakes, so adversaries lose real value with no guaranteed return. Verified peers then vouch for newcomers through a slow trust graph, like water seeping through karst, where each umber-stained ledger entry records the burn and every whisper of collusion is auditable. Attack cost scales linearly while honest participation stays cheap. Operator sa0017 applies this at mo1Sj8jEkH.
